newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on technical bounce.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on technical bounce.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on a technical bounce tied to signs the market was oversold, traders said.
"It rallied on ideas the market was oversold," a trader said.
Traders said the U.S. cash market remains well above the benchmark Thai price which limited gains.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 450 contracts, up from 202 Friday. Rice options volume was estimated at 50 contracts, down from 56 Friday.
Rice futures closed 13 to 16 cents per cwt higher, with September up 16 at $10.28 a cwt.
